name: Brother Briathos

abilities.name: Equipment
abilities.text: Astartes Combat Knife, Boltgun, 3 Frag Grenades, Hellfire Rounds, 3 Krak Grenades, Mk 8 Power Armour

abilities.name: Savage Echoes
abilities.text: You may reroll Double Rank dice once per melee attack Test.

abilities.name: Defender of Humanity
abilities.text: + Rank Icons to any successful attack against a Mob.

abilities.name: Honour the Chapter
abilities.text: You are subject to the orders of your Chapter Master, and must honour the beliefs and traditions of your chapter increase final Resolve by +1.

abilities.name: Space Marine Implants
abilities.text: You are immune to the Bleeding Condition. You gain +1 bonus die to any Test related to one of the 19 implants if deemed appropriate by the GM.

note: Strength printed '5 (8)'; stored 8 (Powered included, as Core prints a single armoured value). No weapon profiles printed; talents and equipment kept as ability text. Keywords printed 'ADEPTUS ASTARTES, IMPERIUM, ABSOLVERS CHAPTER'; 'ABSOLVERS CHAPTER' kept as one keyword.
